eurostat.basis: EU statistical data reuse; selected EU/euro-area macro tables, not excluded third-country or restricted detailed trade data

ons.basis: OGL v3; original ONS statistical tables, no licensed images or other excluded material
ons.attribution: Office for National Statistics, Crown copyright, OGL v3

desnz.basis: OGL v3; original Energy Trends statistics; native table units and notes retained
desnz.attribution: DESNZ, Energy Trends September 2026, Crown copyright, OGL v3

uk_building_materials.basis: OGL v3 applies to selected DBT-authored columns only; BCIS and MPA columns excluded
uk_building_materials.attribution: Department for Business and Trade, Crown copyright, OGL v3

eia.basis: EIA-authored statistics in these identified historical files; no separately protected third-party material selected

usgs.basis: USGS-authored domestic Mineral Industry Surveys tables; estimated totals and units retained
usgs.attribution: US Geological Survey, Mineral Industry Surveys

bls.basis: Original federal BLS statistical observations, public domain; no proprietary third-party index selected

bea.basis: Original BEA NIPA tables, public domain; no third-party content selected

census.basis: Original Census C30 statistical tables are federal works; not a licence inference from mere API availability
census.attribution: US Census Bureau, Value of Construction Put in Place

federal_reserve.basis: Original Board/Treasury statistics; H15 effective federal funds rate requires separate NY Fed reference-rate notice review
federal_reserve.attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

ecb.basis: Selected ESCB-produced rates, reference FX and monetary statistics; source metadata unchanged, third-party data excluded
